{{Infobox auto}}

'''Steamed carrots''' are the simple preparation of the [[carrot]]. They heal {{Hp|2}} and grant {{EffectLink|Night Vision}} for 10 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/steamed_carrots.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A carrot cooks into steamed carrots in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds. Picking up a carrot unlocks the oven recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating steamed carrots takes 0.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|2}} and gives Night Vision for 0:10.

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
